checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handle extends out of the frame on the right side; the end of the handle and any potential hanging hole are not visible.
The interior walls of the pan slope outward from the base, consistent with standard skillet design.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The browning spots on the flatbread appear slightly repetitive and lack natural irregularity, resembling a stamped pattern rather than organic charring.

The edge where the pan rim meets the stove grate is slightly soft and indistinct. The grate bars seem to merge subtly with the pan's outer wall rather than sitting distinctly behind or in front of it.
The stove knobs in the upper right background appear slightly warped and lack sharp geometric definition, common in AI-generated backgrounds.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a frying pan and distinguish it from other cookware like woks or sauté pans.
To verify the physical separation between the pan and the stove grate, checking for fusion or bleeding artifacts at the contact points.
To analyze the statistical naturalness of the browning patterns on the bread and detect any generative repetition or smearing.
To ensure the depth of the pan is consistent and the background elements (knobs) are correctly positioned in 3D space relative to the pan.

Geometric consistency of stove knobs in background
